osdi_crf_noise.description: fake OSDI crf_noise (conductance g, PSD 4kTg + 2q|g v|) shunt at node X; X between two series 1 F DC blocks to the ports and DC-fed from Vdc through a 1 H choke
osdi_crf_noise.formula: F = 1 + (T/T0) g Z0 + 2q|g Vdc| Z0/(4 k T0); S21 = 2/(2+gZ0), S11 = -gZ0/(2+gZ0); Cs = S_i Z0/(2+gZ0)^2 [[1,1],[1,1]] with S_i = 4kTg + 2q|g Vdc|. The loading by g cancels in NF.
osdi_crf_noise.notes: White noise: frequency-independent. The 1 F blocks and 1 H choke move NF by ~1e-17 at 1 GHz. NFmin/Rn/Gamma_opt are degenerate (a shunt noise current at the input: Rn -> 0, Gamma_opt -> -1, Fmin -> 1) and are not references.
